enchantment.gadgetworks.electric_field.d: Surrounds the wearer with an electric field that shocks nearby hostile mobs. Only fits Copper Boots.

tooltip.gadgetworks.electric_sword: Strikes arc lightning to up to 3 nearby mobs.
tooltip.gadgetworks.magnetic_double_swor: Sneak + right-click to flip the blade.
tooltip.gadgetworks.redstone_staff: Sneak + right-click to cycle modes. Right-click to use.
message.gadgetworks.golem_limit: You already control 3 mini redstone golems.
tooltip.gadgetworks.ground_breaking_hamm: Right-click on the ground to slam a shockwave that damages and launches mobs.
tooltip.gadgetworks.electric_sword_activ: Right-click to Arc Strike the mob you are looking at.
tooltip.gadgetworks.magnetic_double_swor: Right-click to magnetize all mobs around you.
tooltip.gadgetworks.frostbrand_axe: Hits chill enemies, slowing and weakening them.
tooltip.gadgetworks.frostbrand_axe_activ: Right-click to unleash a Frost Nova.
